name: npi-lookup
description: Check provider rosters against live registry records and download Excel and CSV files.

interface.longDescription:
NPI lookup for credentialing staff: check a provider roster using live registry data and download XLSX and CSV files.

Use bulk npi lookup to check up to 40 provider numbers with optional expected names, practice states and taxonomy codes. Invalid check digits are flagged locally. Review active status, provider or organization names, taxonomy codes, practice and mailing addresses, secondary locations and update dates. Name and state searches show up to 10 matches per search, with up to 10 searches per call.

The workbook separates providers, taxonomies, addresses and source information for npi verification for credentialing. Compare mismatches in the widget and download the roster for follow-up. Download links expire in about one hour.

Limits: CMS NPPES NPI Registry data is provider-reported enumeration data, not licensure, board certification, sanctions or payer enrolment. Deactivated numbers may appear as Not found. A check digit cannot prove issuance. Records can be cached for 24 hours and searches for 6 hours. Do not enter patient information.

Verify NPI number 1245319599: practice state VA, taxonomy 207Q00000X
NPI registry search: last name Smith, first name John, state MA

positive.prompt: NPI lookup: 1245319599 and 1003000126, give me the taxonomy and practice address
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a row for each provider, with source details, status, taxonomy, practice address and roster download links; reports registry errors per row.

positive.prompt: NPI registry search: last name Smith, first name John, state MA
positive.expected_behavior: Returns provider matches by name and state with source details and search download links, or a per-search registry error.

positive.prompt: Verify NPI number 1245319599: practice state VA, taxonomy 207Q00000X
positive.expected_behavior: Compares expected state and taxonomy with the retrieved record and provides the check result and roster downloads; reports a registry error if unavailable.

positive.prompt: NPI search: last name Smith, state MA
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matches and a narrowing hint when there are more matches, or a per-search registry error, plus download links.
Reports Invalid NPI with expected check digit 3 without a registry request and offers roster downloads.

pl-PL.subtitle: Weryfikacja numerów NPI
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź listę publicznych numerów NPI i porównaj nazwy, stany oraz kody taksonomii z rejestrem. Wyszukuj według nazwiska i stanu. Pobierz pliki XLSX i CSV; linki wygasają po około godzinie. Dane rejestru nie potwierdzają uprawnień ani udziału w ubezpieczeniu. Nie wpisuj danych pacjentów.

de-DE.subtitle: NPI-Listen prüfen
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie öffentliche NPI-Listen und vergleichen Sie Namen, Bundesstaaten und Taxonomie-Codes mit Registerdaten. Suchen Sie nach Name und Bundesstaat. XLSX- und CSV-Links gelten etwa eine Stunde. Registerdaten belegen keine Zulassung oder Versicherungsbeteiligung. Keine Patientendaten eingeben.

es-ES.subtitle: Consulta y verifica NPI
es-ES.description: Verifica listas públicas de NPI y compara nombres, estados y códigos de taxonomía con el registro. Busca por nombre y estado. Descarga XLSX y CSV; los enlaces caducan en una hora aproximadamente. Los datos no acreditan licencias ni participación en seguros. No introduzcas información de pacientes.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vérification des listes NPI
fr-FR.description: Vérifiez des listes publiques NPI et comparez noms, États et codes de taxonomie avec le registre. Recherchez par nom et État. Téléchargez les fichiers XLSX et CSV ; les liens expirent après environ une heure. Le registre ne prouve ni autorisation d’exercice ni affiliation à un assureur. Ne saisissez aucune donnée de patient.

ja-JP.subtitle: NPI名簿の検索と確認
ja-JP.description: 公開NPI名簿を登録データと照合し、氏名、州、分類コードを確認できます。氏名と州で検索し、XLSXとCSVをダウンロードできます。リンクは約1時間で失効します。登録情報は免許、専門資格、保険加入の証明ではありません。患者情報は入力しないでください。

pt-BR.subtitle: Consulta e verificação NPI
pt-BR.description: Verifique listas públicas de NPI e compare nomes, estados e códigos de taxonomia com o registro. Pesquise por nome e estado. Baixe arquivos XLSX e CSV; os links expiram em cerca de uma hora. Os dados não comprovam licença nem participação em seguros. Não insira informações de pacientes.
